1. TO VOTE YOU MUST COMPLETELY
BLACKEN THE OVAL TO THE RIGHT OF
YOUR CHOICE. An oval darkened
indicates a vote for that candidate. Do
not select more candidates than
permitted in each race.
2. To cast a write-in vote for a person
whose name is not on the ballot,
blacken the oval beside the “Write-in”
line and write his/her name legibly in the
space provided.
3. If you make a mistake on your ballot,
DO NOT ERASE OR CROSS OUT,
request a new ballot.

STACY GARRITY - Governor
JASON RICHEY - Lt Governor
REPUBLICAN
